correctness.rationale: Reassessed /workspace/repairs/5/RESULT.md. Radius variable t=|z|²/(1−|z|²) gives the stated positive diagonal beta-prime eigenvalues, and splitting 2m ternary digits gives the translates of μ_m. The CDF bound follows by induction on each branch (on the right, 1+u^δ≤(2+u)^δ by monotonicity of the difference; the middle gap has CDF 1/2); rescaling gives F_m(t)≤t^δ even beyond the support. For k≥1, Stieltjes integration by parts discards the nonpositive term on the rising side of g_k and bounds the rest by ∫_(k/2)^∞ t^δ(−g_k')dt. Ordinary integration by parts yields A_k plus the truncated beta integral; J_k is decreasing by its gamma recurrence, and A_x decreases for x≥2 from log(1+2/x)≥2/(x+1) and δ<2/3. For k=1 the missing piece of the full beta integral is kept as a subtraction and bounded using (1+t)^3≤(3/2)^3 up to 1/2. The four-cylinder Jensen lower bound uses exact means 1/6 and 5/6. Independent bounded replay: python3 /workspace/branches/independent_exact_replay.py; exact rational interval arithmetic verifies the dimension, sine, exponential, beta-integral and Jensen inequalities (vacuum lower ≈0.62900005 and first-mode upper ≈0.62095097 in the independent enclosure). Higher modes are uniformly below 0.600. Thus the normalized spectral gap is strictly greater than 1/200 and the claimed squared-distance estimate follows by expansion in the diagonal basis. Local weak convergence follows from the fixed digit decomposition, and the tail is O(R^(δ−2)) uniformly by the CDF bound and integration by parts, establishing the vacuum series, its positivity and finiteness. The approximate decimal is not a certificate. The frozen CHECK.py was inspected, not executed. No claim for odd stages, general weights or arbitrary dilations is needed for the repaired gap.
